C1188.title: CVE-2024-21626 Container Escape Vulnerability
C1188.summary: CVE-2024-21626, disclosed on January 31, 2024, stems from leaked internal file descriptors in runc. An attacker able to start or execute a container can place the container process working directory inside the host filesystem namespace and read host files. A malicious image can also use the leaked descriptors to overwrite host binaries and escape the container.
